correctness.rationale: A self-contained integer-inequality proof forces the first possible electorate size to eleven and derives the exact two-family normal form. Two exhaustive finite traversal orders then agree on the same sixty harmful events, and all orbit, uniqueness, and incidence identities are checked with exact arithmetic.

value.rationale: The result completely resolves the first tie-independent three-candidate no-show boundary for a canonical voting rule. It converts prior existence/minimality into a structural theorem: two explicit one-parameter families exhaust all witnesses, with exact incidence, symmetry, and move uniqueness. The boundary is mathematically motivated by the established minimum rather than chosen arbitrarily.
